scope: Discovery query and loading strategy; actual resident tool changes require a trusted deployment adapter
protectedPolicy: Use only published tools. Newly discovered/loaded tools are available next step, not in the current call. Broaden queries when results are uncertain. Do not replace sandbox or authorization boundaries.

query.initial: Search capabilities with concise English operation keywords.
values: Search capabilities with concise English operation keywords.

loading.initial: Prefer existing suitable tools. Discover only missing capabilities. Avoid repeatedly loading the same tool. Keep a stable tool set for a task phase. If top candidates do not fit, broaden discovery instead of forcing a near match.
